description: Atomically claim a task/handoff. session_id must identify this Codex run. A competing active claim returns claim_conflict. Keep lease_token; pass it to renew or update. Claims expire automatically; no background worker.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse on retries. If omitted, identical arguments deduplicate automatically.

lease_token.description: Existing lease token, only when renewing.

session_id.description: Stable Codex chat/run identifier. Optional except when claiming work.

name: relay_claim
